caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass bowl placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bowl is oval-shaped with a wide rim that curves outward slightly and has a shallow depth. The glass appears light blue-green, with subtle shading and highlights that suggest its reflective and translucent nature. The sides of the bowl feature wavy, lobed contours with several raised and rounded decorative elements integrated into the structure. There are no other objects or patterns present in the composition, and the entire focus is on the detailed rendering of the glass bowl.
title: Bowl
